source='''def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the four 3-row color layers, keeping the highest-priority color."""
    out = []
    for r in range(3):
        row = []
        for c in range(6):
            value = 0
            for color, start in ((2, 6), (8, 9), (4, 3), (5, 0)):
                if grid[start + r][c] == color:
                    value = color
            row.append(value)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
